S5-T3 chose its misspelling rule (fuzzy-v1) on the misspelling slice; ruling 7 of its plan and orchestrator ruling 10 require a held-out misspelling slice, judged before any expansion code, with today's cells recorded before the build

S5-T5 chooses its verb-form rule R on the morphology slices; ruling 4 of its task file requires a held-out verb-form slice in new files, judged and committed with today's cells before any code of R exists on either surface and before any run of those queries through a candidate

The S5-T8 re-ruling after the verifier's measurement (13 Nov), item 3: the verifier's 16 second-letter and 9 first-letter typed words of 6 and 7 code points, each as the short question it ran, with every file holding the meant word as the answer; written by someone who had not seen the rule's design; recorded with the engine that ships (fold-groups-v3, fuzzy-v1); the first-letter rows record a measured gap, not a regression; the bar the next fuzzy task must not lower
